title: University expands cooperation with Chinese institutions
summary: Agreements on academic exchange and joint programmes in logistics and marine engineering have been signed.

body.text: Admiral Ushakov State Maritime University signed cooperation agreements with two Chinese universities. The documents provide for academic exchange, staff internships and joint research.
The parties plan to launch joint modules in logistics and marine engineering in the next academic year.
